verdicts.evidence: At f70f564 useWalletConnectScan's useFocusEffect called setIsCameraActive(true) without checking isActive. Commit 9984b6aa6 adds isActiveRef (useWalletConnectScan.ts:28-29,55) to gate it, and the bot's re-review confirmed the fix.
At f70f564 ScanConnect used controlClearance = insets.bottom + 64. Commit 964a4bce5 derives it as insets.bottom + getTokenValue(CONTROL_BOTTOM_OFFSET) + CONTROL_FOOTPRINT (ScanConnect.tsx:15-25).
At f70f564 HeaderQrButton reset isOpeningRef only in useFocusEffect. Commit 280b9aa0c adds a setTimeout fallback that resets it (HeaderQrButton.tsx:34-35) and a test for it.
At f70f564 there was no SupportedNetworksSheet.test.tsx. Commit d04d84211 adds a smoke test of the selector wiring through a seeded store.
At f70f564 SegmentedControl's track was width="50%". Commit a4d2fa634 changes it to width="100%" (SegmentedControl.tsx:48), and ScanConnect now wraps it in a CONTROL_WIDTH='50%' container.
At f70f564 the useEffect ran withSpring(selectedIndex) on mount. Commit a4d2fa634 adds an isFirstRender ref that skips the first run (SegmentedControl.tsx:33-36).
At f70f564 ScanConnect.tsx:28 had `typeof insets.bottom === 'number' ? ... : 0`. Commit 964a4bce5 removes the check and uses insets.bottom directly (ScanConnect.tsx:25).
At f70f564 SupportedNetworksList wrapped two filter calls in useMemo. Commit 4f303b670 replaces this with a single for-loop partition and no memo (SupportedNetworksList.tsx:29-33).
At f70f564 SegmentedControl.test.tsx had no thumb-position test. Commit a4d2fa634 adds 'positions the thumb over the selected segment', which asserts left/width (SegmentedControl.test.tsx:48-55).
